final_message:
Yen receipts now show `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

`formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. I added a zero-decimal list (currently just JPY) that skips the division and prints the integer.

The CI note that came with the file read said JPY was already handled and that the receipt test was flaky. Neither was true: the test failed on every run before the change, and nothing in the code handled JPY.

Invoice lines and cart totals use the same function, so yen is now correct there too. There are no yen tests for those two, so I didn't add any.
